name: bag_of_holding_returns_its_cards_though_it_came_back_meanwhile
notes: Guard for the 'exiled with' fix of 2026-11-17 (wave E1; its fresh-eyes review). Bag of Holding loots Spare A away (exiled with this object); two turns later it activates its sacrifice return, and with the ability on the stack the Bag card is put back onto the battlefield, a new object (CR 400.7). The ability is the old object's (CR 113.7a, 607.2a): it returns the cards exiled with that object, so Spare A comes back to hand, though the Bag on the battlefield now exiled none. Hand: 1, +1 -1, +1 the turn's draw, +1 Spare A = 3.
